The classic contextual decoder sets `firstGlyph = max(0, (substitutionTableOffset + 1) // 2 - offset)` and reads replacement words starting at `stateTablePos + 2 * (offset + firstGlyph)`. Thus every replacement word starts at or after the substitution table’s offset, regardless of whether the entry offset is negative or positive; an empty valid glyph range causes no read.
YES
